hero.title: Find your calm, matched to how you feel.
hero.subtitle: Tell us how you're feeling and we'll match you to the rhythm and atmosphere that fits best.
pick.title: 4-7-8 Sleep + Fireplace
pick.body: A slow 4-second inhale, 7-second hold, and 8-second exhale paired with a crackling fireplace atmosphere - built to ease you toward sleep.
reasons.title: Why we picked this for you
reason-1.title: Matches your evenings
reason-1.body: Longer exhales calm the nervous system, which is exactly what late-day stress needs.
reason-2.title: Built for winding down
reason-2.body: The 4/7/8 rhythm is the most requested preset before bedtime among Breathe users.
reason-3.title: A softer atmosphere
reason-3.body: The fireplace backdrop downloads once and plays offline, so it's ready whenever you need it.

item-2.title: Relax + River
